models_evaluated: multivariable logistic regression DVT risk model

links.outcome: Model discrimination in derivation versus bootstrap-validation cohort
links.effect: Derivation AUC 0.83 (95% CI 0.78-0.89); bootstrap validation AUC 0.81 (95% CI 0.75-0.87). Internal validation only, single center.
links.quote: The model achieved superior discrimination (derivation cohort: AUC = 0.83, 95% CI: 0.78-0.89; validation cohort: AUC = 0.81, 95% CI: 0.75-0.87) compared to existing risk assessment tools.

screen.reason: Evaluates the development, internal validation, and clinical implementation impact (reduction in screening, anticoagulation, costs) of a predictive risk model for DVT following meningioma surgery, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard/guardrail practice.
